summary: Silent Waves and research partners demonstrated a superconducting travelling-wave parametric amplifier with built-in isolation.
quote: A collaborative team from Institut Néel (University Grenoble Alpes CNRS Grenoble INP), Silent Waves, with partners from Karlsruhe Institute of Technology and the University of Strasbourg has demonstrated a new superconducting travelling wave parametric amplifier with built in isolation.
